children.value: > Fact From Story: Kelce has also acknowledged the heavy public attention around his private life as a result of his relationship, noting he’s “never dated anyone with that kind of aura around them”.

> > Fact From Story: “The scrutiny she gets, how much she has a magnifying glass on her, every single day, paparazzi outside her house, outside every restaurant she goes to, after every flight she gets off, and she’s just living, enjoying life.
> > > Fact From Story: Swift also confirmed that when she famously first attended Kelce’s game at Arrowhead Stadium in September, she was already dating the NFL star.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Dating is a private life event that becomes public if the people involved are famous.
> > Fact From Story: But, according to Kelce, he’s not letting the media affect his relationship.
> > > Fact From Story: “I’ve never been a man of words. Being around her, seeing how smart Taylor is, has been f***ing mind-blowing. I’m learning every day,” he explained.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Being in a relationship with someone can be a learning experience.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Celebrities often have to deal with paparazzi and media attention.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When a celebrity relationship garners attention, it becomes a topic of discussion in the media.
